projects.name: SQUARES
projects.fullTitle: Sustainability and Quality Assurance for Academic Governance and Redesign Engineering Studies
projects.summary: Erasmus+ capacity-building project to strengthen transversal skills and quality management in civil and industrial engineering courses.

detail.programme: Erasmus+ (call ERASMUS-EDU-2023-CBHE), funded by the European Union; granting authority EACEA
detail.duration: 36 months (the old page gives no start or end date; the kick-off meeting was 8-11 January 2024)
detail.about: The project addresses gaps in transversal skills (such as energy-saving technologies, new construction materials and logistics) in civil and industrial engineering courses in Asian countries with limited academic resources. It also aims to introduce systematic quality management and continuous improvement into course governance.
detail.cstRole: CST joined to build capacity in accreditation and internationalisation. Its Electrical Engineering and Information Technology programmes are being prepared for accreditation with support from the SSAPI project.
objectives: Enhance transversal skills in energy management, new building technologies and urban transport systems.
Steer course governance toward systematic quality management and continuous improvement.
Bridge gaps between higher education institutions, industry and employers to improve graduate employability.
domains: Energy saving and efficiency in civil buildings
Energy management for civil and industrial infrastructure
detail.coordinator: Capital University of Science and Technology, Pakistan
partners: College of Science and Technology, Royal University of Bhutan
National University of Sciences and Technology
meetings: Office of the Vice Chancellor, RUB, Thimphu, Bhutan

detail.programme: Erasmus+ Programme, Key Action 2 (Capacity Building in Higher Education), funded by the European Union
detail.about: The project creates learning and practice opportunities for staff, students and researchers at partner-country higher education institutions. Training focuses on learning from EU partners and developing procedures to modernise education, contributing to reforms across the partner institutions' higher education systems.
detail.cstRole: Build capacity in academic programme accreditation and internationalisation at the Royal University of Bhutan, and help RUB programmes gain international recognition.
objectives: Build capacity in academic programme accreditation and internationalisation at the Royal University of Bhutan.
Help RUB's programmes gain international recognition.
Support modernisation and reform of partner institutions' education systems.
outputs: Accreditation documents for two engineering programmes at CST: the Bachelor of Electrical Engineering and the Bachelor of Engineering in Information Technology.
